title: Vietnamese-Style Grilled Pork Chả Giò
description: A delicious and flavorful Vietnamese dish featuring grilled pork and crispy cha giò. This recipe is perfect for a quick and easy dinner.
instructions: In a blender or food processor, combine fish sauce, ginger, garlic, and black pepper. Blend until smooth.
Place the pork shoulder in a large bowl and pour the blended sauce over it. Mix well to coat.
Let the pork marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Grill the pork shoulder for 5-7 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Meanwhile, heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the shrimp paste and cook for 1-2 minutes, or until fragrant.
Add the bean sprouts and cook for 2-3 minutes, or until tender.
To assemble the cha giò, lay a rice paper roll on a flat surface.
Add a few lettuce leaves, a few bean sprouts, and a slice of grilled pork to the center of the roll.
Fold the bottom half of the roll up over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll up tightly.
Serve the cha giò hot with your favorite dipping sauce.
